title: Standardized spares across sites
background: Five plants kept separate spare-part lists, which made emergency swaps slow and expensive.
selection: A single accuracy class was chosen across sites; the range variant differs only where the duty point requires it.
results: Any site can borrow from another.
One document set now serves all five sites.
seoTitle: Standardized spares across sites — deployment note
seoDescription: Standardized spares across sites: constraints, models chosen and measurable results. A short deployment note for engineers comparing similar setups.

zh.title: 多站点统一备件
zh.background: 五个工厂各自维护备件清单，紧急替换既慢又贵。
zh.selection: 各站点统一精度等级，仅在工况点不同的位置保留量程差异。
results: 只需维护一套技术文件。
五个站点共用一套技术文件。
zh.seoTitle: 五站点统一备件：料号收敛与跨站调拨现场可用。
zh.seoDescription: 五个站点统一备件的做法：各站点采用相同精度等级，仅在工况点不同处保留量程差异，备件库存减半并可跨站调拨，同时记录料号收敛与维护文件的变化。现场可用。
